items.title: File Adams County business personal property return
items.description: Washington personal property listings are due to the county assessor by April 30 for equipment held on January 1. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month the list is late, up to 25% (RCW 84.40).

items.title: File King County business personal property return
items.description: Washington personal property listings are due to the county assessor by April 30 for equipment held on January 1. Listings can be filed on paper or through eListing; late listings take a 5% monthly penalty up to 25%, and no extensions are granted.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file the return; the personal property tax is billed on the assessed value at the local rate.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month the list is late, up to 25% (RCW 84.40).

items.title: Get and renew the King County food establishment health permit
items.description: Submit plans for review before construction, remodeling or a change of ownership (a review can take up to 3 weeks). Permanent food business permits renew by March 31 through the Public Health Permit Center; the annual fee depends on risk level. A new owner must apply again, with no proration.

feeDetail.note: The applicable authority sets fees by license or permit type; confirm the current schedule before filing.

penalty.note: Late penalties and enforcement fines vary by jurisdiction; confirm the current schedule before filing.
